market_readiness_name: Binance BTC/USDT Spot Market Observation Specification

semantic_price_distinction.bookTicker: Top-of-book best bid and best ask quotes. Strictly prohibited from being treated as executed trade prices.
semantic_price_distinction.klines: Aggregated executed trades (OHLCV, volume, trade count). Used for return and volatility measurements.
semantic_price_distinction.rule_enforcement: MarketDataSpecificationError raised if bookTicker is supplied for trade-price returns.

candle_integrity_rules.partial_candle_handling: Candles whose close_time > wall_clock_time are flagged as partial and excluded from closed-bar metrics.
candle_integrity_rules.missing_candle_handling: Gaps in 1m timestamp sequences are detected and flagged in data continuity status.
